items.summary: Chapter 3 vocabulary review: family, home rooms, belongings, and numbers to seventy.
Rappel 1 revision: numbers, masculine/feminine words, and a general-knowledge multiple-choice quiz.
More revision exercises: matching pictures, describing scenes, filling gaps, personal Q&A practice.
Unit 4 opener: match pet-contest finalists to descriptions; vote on favourite animals.
Dialogue about Sophie's bird and Noah's rat; puzzle matching names to pet animals.
Comic strip about grandma's cats; identify each cat from adjective clues; negation grammar.
Adjective agreement rules; complete colour/size adjective tables; listening and animal description exercises.
Practise question formation and avoir by interviewing partners about their pets.
Write a pet description; avoir verb practice; complete pet-related questions and answers.
Reading about eccentric family pets and their TV/music tastes; true-or-false comprehension check.
Listening table on likes/dislikes (TV, sport, music); match speech bubbles; tu vs vous.
Illustrated poem about a colourful zoo; order animal pictures to match verses.
Unit 4 summary: pets, colours, sizes, qualities, likes/dislikes, and question vocabulary.
Reading: cat Mangetout's self-introduction, and facts about France's geography, food, and sports.
Comic strip on a girl's morning routine; poem about colours; vocabulary-matching exercises.
Unit 5 opener: French festival calendar; listen for dates; identify and spell months.
Continue festival calendar; practise asking dates aloud; find name-day (saint's day) dates.
Reading text describing French festivals and traditions throughout the year, month by month.
Guess vocabulary meanings from festival text; match festivals to months; grammar of 'on'.
Mardi gras carnival intro; listening comprehension and matching costumed characters to names.
Verb être practice; match sentence halves; describe costumed mardi gras photos.
Reading about Marc's birthday and gifts; birthday interview role-play; match gifts to owners.
Choose correct adjective forms describing reactions to gifts; adjective agreement grammar rules.
Gift catalogue poster with prices; listen and match named presents to catalogue letters.
Higher numbers 70-1,000,000; choose ideal gifts for people; tombola raffle prize matching.
Reading about Lou Leroux's outfits over a week; build a clothing vocabulary list.
Identify plural clothing words; plural noun grammar; true-or-false about Lou's outfits.
Listen and match personal descriptions to portraits; write and describe hair/eye appearance.
Avoir verb practice; read Léa's email about family/pets/home; write your own email.
Listening skills practice: near-homophone words, question-vs-answer tone, and Suzanne's party story.
